key_points: Record Q3 revenue of $6.76B (+13% YoY), raised full-year guidance, and AI monetization finally showing in revenue — fundamentals are stronger than the stock's 27% YoY decline suggests.
Valuation at ~9x forward earnings is unusually cheap for a software company with $30B ARR, creating asymmetric upside if monetization recovery holds.
Q4 revenue guidance missed some expectations, capping enthusiasm and explaining mixed analyst reactions (JPMorgan cut PT to $315 but kept OW; Morgan Stanley remains cautious).
New CEO appointment and freemium strategy create near-term uncertainty, but user growth milestones are building a foundation for future monetization.
AI-disruption fears easing sector-wide is a tailwind; software stocks rallying while chip stocks sell off suggests rotation into value software names like ADBE.
